subject: Kickoff: DP transfer-learning recipe (dp_transfer)
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off the DP transfer recipe work for trust-theory. The headline from our open-source release: with the right recommendations, private last-layer fine-tuning on pre-trained features reaches ~88% top-1 on ImageNet-1k at (epsilon=8, delta=8e-7) — state of the art, and computationally cheap because only the last layer trains.

Product story: an internal "private fine-tuning" recipe that any team with a pre-trained backbone can apply. The release already packages four methods — DP-Adam, DP-Newton, DP-LS, and DP-FC — with self-contained sanitizers, so the engineering here is configs, docs, and validation on two internal classification workloads.

Window is tight (we close mid-April), so: internal validation done by March 20, recipe doc and configs published April 6, handoff review April 13.

Bao to follow with staffing plus the forward-looking compute budget ask for the scale-up.

Ximena
